description: When only maximum storage will do, the Newport 7 Drawer Dresser delivers. Seven dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides offer abundant space for your growing child's wardrobe, from baby onesies through school-age clothes. Solid hardwood construction and a warm Brown Maple finish create a piece that feels both substantial and beautiful. The spacious top is ready for a changing pad for those early months. Coordinates with the full Newport collection for a complete nursery look. Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes throughout.
